_comment: Maps each rule/finding id to ONE of the properties declared in config/project.json:property_order (the kit's default hierarchy is Data integrity/State correctness/Identity-uniqueness/Auditability/Recoverability/Security/Performance/UX, but any project declares its own). 'rules' empty on purpose: v1 unreviewed until the project owner fills it in, rule by rule, with its own epistemic 'why'. Full example instantiated over a critical-flow domain (32 real rules) in config/examples/critical-flow/property-hierarchy-map.json.
